test_QuestDataProvider_quest_recording: test the QuestDataProvider class by loading a Quest3 VRS recording and validating image streams and calibration
create_QuestDataProvider_from_vrs: create a QuestDataProvider instance from a VRS file path and device calibration JSON file
get_image_from_stream: get a grayscale image array from a specific stream ID and timestamp using QuestDataProvider
get_camera_calibration_fisheye_linear: get the camera calibration intrinsics and extrinsics for a stream using FISHEYE624 or LINEAR model
get_frameset_from_timestamp: get a frameset dictionary mapping stream IDs to closest timestamps within an acceptable time difference
